package smb

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"syscall"
	"testing"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
)

func posixCapabilityExpected() []byte {
	return []byte{0x06, 0x04, 0, 0, 0xff, 0, 0, 0, 18, 0, 0, 0, 'r', 0, 'e', 0, 'm', 0, 'o', 0, 't', 0, 'e', 0, '-', 0, 'f', 0, 's', 0}
}

type posixCapabilityBackend struct {
	windowsBackend
	calls int
	err   error
}

func (b *posixCapabilityBackend) State(context.Context) (windowsState, error) {
	b.calls++
	return windowsState{VolumeIdentity: "known-fixture", VolumeSerial: 0x123456789}, b.err
}
func (*posixCapabilityBackend) Space(context.Context) (storage.Space, error) {
	return storage.Space{Total: 100, Used: 60, Avail: 30}, nil
}

func TestGatePosixCapabilityExactFilesystemAttributes(t *testing.T) {
	d, _, _, _ := commandDispatcher()
	backend := &posixCapabilityBackend{}
	d.backend = backend
	body, status := d.filesystemInfo(t.Context(), 5)
	if status != 0 || !bytes.Equal(body, posixCapabilityExpected()) {
		t.Fatalf("class5 status=%x body=%x", status, body)
	}
	baseline := bytes.Clone(posixCapabilityExpected())
	smbLE.PutUint32(baseline, 6)
	if smbLE.Uint32(body)^smbLE.Uint32(baseline) != 0x400 || !bytes.Equal(body[4:], baseline[4:]) {
		t.Fatal("filesystem attributes changed beyond capability bit")
	}
	if backend.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatal("capability query introduced State lookup")
	}
	for _, class := range []byte{1, 3, 4, 7, 11} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("class%d", class), func(t *testing.T) {
			actual, status := d.filesystemInfo(t.Context(), class)
			var expected []byte
			switch class {
			case 1:
				expected = make([]byte, 30)
				smbLE.PutUint32(expected[8:], 0x23456789)
				smbLE.PutUint32(expected[12:], 12)
				copy(expected[18:], []byte{'v', 0, 'o', 0, 'l', 0, 'u', 0, 'm', 0, 'e', 0})
			case 3:
				expected = make([]byte, 24)
				smbLE.PutUint64(expected, 100)
				smbLE.PutUint64(expected[8:], 30)
				smbLE.PutUint32(expected[16:], 1)
				smbLE.PutUint32(expected[20:], 1)
			case 4:
				expected = []byte{7, 0, 0, 0, 0x10, 0, 0, 0}
			case 7:
				expected = make([]byte, 32)
				smbLE.PutUint64(expected, 100)
				smbLE.PutUint64(expected[8:], 30)
				smbLE.PutUint64(expected[16:], 40)
				smbLE.PutUint32(expected[24:], 1)
				smbLE.PutUint32(expected[28:], 1)
			case 11:
				expected = make([]byte, 28)
				for _, at := range []int{0, 4, 8, 12} {
					smbLE.PutUint32(expected[at:], 1)
				}
			}
			if status != 0 || !bytes.Equal(actual, expected) {
				t.Fatalf("unrelated class%d changed: %x %x", class, status, actual)
			}
		})
	}
	if backend.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatal("volume serial lookup changed", backend.calls)
	}
}

type posixCapabilityFile struct {
	*commandFile
	syncs int
}

func (f *posixCapabilityFile) Sync(context.Context) error { f.syncs++; return f.readErr }
func TestGatePosixCapabilityQueryFailureBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"exact", "short", "sync-outage", "closed"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			d, file, _, id := commandDispatcher()
			tracked := &posixCapabilityFile{commandFile: file}
			d.handles[id].file = tracked
			limit := uint32(len(posixCapabilityExpected()))
			want := uint32(0)
			switch name {
			case "short":
				limit--
				want = fileBufferTooSmall
			case "sync-outage":
				file.readErr = syscall.EIO
				want = fileIOError
			case "closed":
				delete(d.handles, id)
				want = fileClosed
			}
			request := queryCommand(id, 2, 5, limit)
			before := bytes.Clone(request.Packet)
			body, status := d.queryInfo(t.Context(), request)
			if status != want || !bytes.Equal(request.Packet, before) {
				t.Fatalf("query status=%x want=%x", status, want)
			}
			if name == "exact" {
				if len(body) != 38 || smbLE.Uint16(body) != 9 || smbLE.Uint16(body[2:]) != 72 || smbLE.Uint32(body[4:]) != 30 || !bytes.Equal(body[8:], posixCapabilityExpected()) {
					t.Fatalf("query framing %x", body)
				}
			} else if body != nil {
				t.Fatal("failed query fabricated attributes", body)
			}
			wantSyncs := 1
			if name == "closed" {
				wantSyncs = 0
			}
			if tracked.syncs != wantSyncs {
				t.Fatal("query skipped or repeated Sync", tracked.syncs)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGatePosixCapabilityPreservesRequestedOnlyQFid(t *testing.T) {
	for _, requested := range []bool{false, true} {
		for _, outage := range []bool{false, true} {
			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("requested%v_outage%v", requested, outage), func(t *testing.T) {
				d, file, session, _ := commandDispatcher()
				d.handles = make(map[wire.FileID]*fileHandle)
				backend := &posixCapabilityBackend{}
				if outage {
					backend.err = syscall.EIO
				}
				d.backend = backend
				opens := 0
				session.open = func(windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error) {
					opens++
					return windowsOpenResult{File: file, Attr: file.attr}, nil
				}
				request := createCommand("", 1, 1)
				if requested {
					request = requestContexts(t, request, []wire.CreateContext{{Name: []byte("QFid")}})
				}
				before := bytes.Clone(request.Packet)
				body, status := d.create(t.Context(), request)
				if !bytes.Equal(request.Packet, before) {
					t.Fatal("CREATE request mutated")
				}
				if requested && outage {
					if status != fileIOError || body != nil || opens != 0 || backend.calls != 1 || len(d.handles) != 0 {
						t.Fatal("requested identity outage bypassed", status, opens, backend.calls)
					}
					return
				}
				if status != 0 || opens != 1 {
					t.Fatal("CREATE admission changed", status, opens)
				}
				if requested {
					if backend.calls != 1 || len(body) != 144 || smbLE.Uint32(body[80:]) != 152 || smbLE.Uint32(body[84:]) != 56 {
						t.Fatalf("requested QFid framing %x", body)
					}
					context := body[88:]
					if smbLE.Uint32(context) != 0 || smbLE.Uint16(context[4:]) != 16 || smbLE.Uint16(context[6:]) != 4 || smbLE.Uint16(context[10:]) != 24 || smbLE.Uint32(context[12:]) != 32 || string(context[16:20]) != "QFid" || smbLE.Uint64(context[24:]) != file.attr.ID || smbLE.Uint64(context[32:]) != 0x123456789 || !bytes.Equal(context[40:], make([]byte, 16)) {
						t.Fatalf("requested QFid values %x", context)
					}
				} else if backend.calls != 0 || len(body) != 88 || smbLE.Uint32(body[80:]) != 0 || smbLE.Uint32(body[84:]) != 0 {
					t.Fatal("always-QFid policy entered fixture", backend.calls, body)
				}
				if body[2] != 0 || d.leases != nil {
					t.Fatal("CREATE gained caching")
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

type posixUnsupportedFile struct {
	windowsFile
	mutations int
}

func (f *posixUnsupportedFile) SetDeletePending(context.Context, bool, windowsActionID) (windowsActionResult, error) {
	f.mutations++
	return windowsActionResult{State: windowsActionCompleted}, nil
}
func (f *posixUnsupportedFile) Rename(context.Context, windowsRenameRequest, windowsActionID) (windowsActionResult, error) {
	f.mutations++
	return windowsActionResult{State: windowsActionCompleted}, nil
}
func TestGatePosixCapabilityKeepsExSetInfoUnsupported(t *testing.T) {
	for _, class := range []byte{64, 65} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("class%d", class), func(t *testing.T) {
			d, file, session, id := commandDispatcher()
			tracked := &posixUnsupportedFile{windowsFile: file}
			d.handles[id].file = tracked
			opens := 0
			session.open = func(windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error) {
				opens++
				return windowsOpenResult{File: file, Attr: file.attr}, nil
			}
			input := make([]byte, 4)
			smbLE.PutUint32(input, 1)
			if class == 65 {
				input = make([]byte, 26)
				smbLE.PutUint32(input, 1)
				smbLE.PutUint32(input[16:], 6)
				copy(input[20:], []byte{'n', 0, 'e', 0, 'w', 0})
			}
			request := setCommand(id, class, input)
			before := bytes.Clone(request.Packet)
			body, status := d.setInfo(t.Context(), request)
			if status != fileNotSupported || body != nil || tracked.mutations != 0 || opens != 0 || d.handleCount() != 1 || d.fenced || session.closed != 0 || file.closed != 0 || !bytes.Equal(request.Packet, before) {
				t.Fatalf("class%d changed behavior: status=%x mutations=%d opens=%d", class, status, tracked.mutations, opens)
			}
		})
	}
}
